title: Swimming
description: Pace /100 m and per-length detail from the available core tables (core.activity, core.sport, core.swim_length). SWOLF is deliberately OMITTED: it would require the pool length, which is stored nowhere in the schema (core.swim_length has neither a distance_m nor a length_m column) — making it up would be an unverifiable assumption about the pool.

options.content: **SWOLF not shown**: this metric requires the pool length, which is absent from `core.swim_length` (no `distance_m`/`length_m` column). The pace below is computed at whole-session level from `core.activity.distance_m` and `core.activity.swim_time_s`, which are actually measured.

panels.title: Swim sessions
panels.description: Pace /100 m = swim_time_s / (distance_m / 100), computed from core.activity (actually measured columns, see COMMENT ON COLUMN core.activity.swim_time_s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date AS "Date", a.name AS "Session", a.distance_m AS "Distance (m)", a.swim_time_s AS "Swim time (s)", CASE WHEN a.distance_m > 0 AND a.swim_time_s > 0 THEN (a.swim_time_s / (a.distance_m / 100.0)) END AS "Pace /100 m (s)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date DESC

SELECT a.local_date::timestamp AS time, (a.swim_time_s / (a.distance_m / 100.0)) AS "Pace /100 m (s)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND a.distance_m > 0 AND a.swim_time_s > 0 AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) ORDER BY a.local_date

panels.title: Lengths per session
panels.description: core.swim_length is the only fine-grained level in the pool, where core.sample is empty (COMMENT ON TABLE core.swim_length). length_type = 'active' excludes rest time at the wall.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.local_date AS "Date", a.name AS "Session", count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Active lengths", avg(l.duration_s) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Avg. duration /length (s)", avg(l.total_strokes) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Avg. strokes /length", avg(l.avg_cadence) FILTER (WHERE l.length_type = 'active') AS "Average cadence" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code JOIN core.swim_length l ON l.activity_id = a.activity_id WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND a.is_parent = false AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY a.activity_id, a.local_date, a.name ORDER BY a.local_date DESC

panels.title: Stroke distribution
panels.description: Number of active lengths per swim_stroke (core.swim_length).

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.swim_stroke AS "Stroke", count(*) AS "Lengths" FROM core.swim_length l JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = l.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE s.discipline = 'swim' AND l.length_type = 'active' AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY l.swim_stroke ORDER BY count(*) DESC
